description: Scan the loaded chunks around you (client-side, works in multiplayer) and update long-term state: the chunk map, remembered workstations/containers/portals/beds (new ones are added, vanished ones marked gone) and ore/wood counts. Optionally locate specific blocks with `find`. Cheap; call it after moving somewhere new.

radius.description: Scan radius in chunks (clamped to what is loaded).

name: observe
title: Observe surroundings
